SELECT t.id, t.type, t.created_at, t.updated_at,
t.u_id, t.u_nickname,
t.s_id, t.s_name,
t.a_road_address_text,
t.rv_rating, t.rv_content,
t.im_url,
t.co_title, t.co_content, t.co_meeting_at, t.co_status, t.co_capacity, t.co_view_count
FROM (
SELECT v.id, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
v.user_id AS u_id, u.nickname AS u_nickname,
v.store_id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name,
a.road_address_text AS a_road_address_text,
v.rating AS rv_rating, v.content AS rv_content,
( SELECT i.url FROM root_image ri JOIN image i ON i.id = ri.image_id WHERE ri.root_id = v.id ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC, ri.image_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS im_url,
NULL AS co_title, NULL AS co_content, NULL AS co_meeting_at, NULL AS co_status, NULL AS co_capacity, NULL AS co_view_count
FROM review v
JOIN root r ON r.id = v.id AND r.type = 'REVIEW' AND
JOIN user u ON u.id = v.user_id
JOIN store s ON s.id = v.store_id
JOIN address a ON a.id = s.address_id
WHERE r.id < #{nextId}
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, r.type, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
c.user_id AS u_id, u.nickname AS u_nickname,
c.store_id AS s_id, s.name AS s_name,
a.road_address_text AS a_road_address_text,
NULL AS rv_rating, NULL AS rv_content,
NULL AS im_url,
c.title AS co_title, c.content AS co_content, c.meeting_at AS co_meeting_at, c.status AS co_status, c.capacity AS co_capacity, c.view_count AS co_view_count
FROM coeat c
JOIN root r ON r.id = c.id AND r.type = 'COEAT' AND
LEFT JOIN store s ON s.id = c.store_id
LEFT JOIN address a ON a.id = s.address_id
JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id
WHERE r.id < #{nextId}
) t
ORDER BY t.id DESC
LIMIT #{size}
